summary_1line: Krishna reveals Bhishma’s nearing death, grants him relief and divine clarity, and urges him to teach Yudhishthira while sages witness auspicious signs.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows while Krishna stands beside him granting a boon as sages gather around.
A celestial shower of flowers falls from the sky as rishis chant and heavenly music fills the air around Krishna, Bhishma, and Yudhishthira.
Bhishma gazes upward from his arrow-bed as radiant deities in fiery chariots wait invisibly in the heavens for his passing.
